source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: Why is literally averaging English words a misleading description of attention?

options.text: Attention combines final answers after the model selects them
options.feedback: Attention operates inside the transformer blocks. It helps shape representations before next-token selection near the output.

options.text: Attention combines source-code rules written for each meaning
options.feedback: The relevant inputs are numerical representations. There need not be a hand-written rule for each interpretation a model develops.
The words help you picture the process, but the mechanism works on numerical representations. The notes describe weighted combinations of those transformed representations.

options.text: Attention combines written definitions retrieved from a database
options.feedback: This replaces one literal word-based picture with another. The computation operates on representations, not retrieved dictionary prose.
